title: Development of novel biochar derived from Bacopa monnieri leaves for adsorptive removal of pendimethalin herbicide from binary and ternary pesticide mixture
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,144-154
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07351K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shreya Thakor, Gautam Priyadarshi, Bhakti Patel, Santosh Kumar Sahu, Sherzodbek Tashbaev, Gulomov Gafurjon Shavkatbek Ugli, Esha Rami, Dipak Kumar Sahoo, Ashish Patel
Bacopa monnieri leaf-derived biochar efficiently removes pendimethalin herbicide from water via adsorption, achieving up to 97.56% removal, as revealed by experimental optimization and mechanism analysis.
